parties_primary_type_matches_role.name: parties_primary_type_matches_role
parties_primary_type_matches_role.value:
("parties"."primary_type" = 'customer' AND "parties"."is_customer")
       OR ("parties"."primary_type" = 'supplier' AND "parties"."is_supplier")
       OR ("parties"."primary_type" = 'employee' AND "parties"."is_employee")
       OR ("parties"."primary_type" = 'other')
